about: Photo filters as film stocks: the Print model with per-filter tone, color and texture. Built by scripts/filmlooks.py; exported with scripts/print-look.py export-swift. Keys left out inherit from Print. grey = display luminance of 18% grey; slope = log-log contrast below the shoulder; shoulder = how hard highlights turn; white/floor = display white and black; printer/crossover = [red, blue] log-exposure offsets / gamma splits; interlayer = saturation; crosstalk = 0..1 of print-dye density coupling; grain = density std at 4032 px.

natural.name: Natural
natural.about: A clean color-negative scan: gentle film curve, open highlights, true color.

warm400.name: Warm 400
warm400.about: Golden portrait negative: warm amber light, lifted shadows, low contrast, pastel color.

portrait.name: Skin
portrait.about: Rosy portrait stock: soft, bright and low-contrast with a gentle pink warmth and calm color.

cool.name: Cool Air
cool.about: Cool consumer negative: cyan-blue light, crisp contrast, quiet muted color.

cine.name: Cine
cine.about: Tungsten cinema negative: dense, teal shadows under warm highlights, strong red glow around lights.

chrome.name: Chrome
chrome.about: Slide film: hard contrast, deep blacks, very rich color and cool-magenta whites.

faded.name: Faded
faded.about: An old print left in the sun: milky blacks, dimmed whites, warm-magenta cast, faded color.

punch.name: Punch

mono400.name: Mono 400
